summary: Implemented REG-FR-06 environment assembly in src/config/env.ts with secrets-file parsing, inline merge where file wins, line-only invalid-name errors, missing-declared-file usage errors, and a redacted diagnostics view; 30 focused tests and all typecheck/lint/full-suite/build checks pass.

payload.agentOutputExcerpt: Implemented REG-FR-06 environment assembly in src/config/env.ts with secrets-file parsing, inline merge where file wins, line-only invalid-name errors, missing-declared-file usage errors, and a redacted diagnostics view; 30 focused tests and all typecheck/lint/full-suite/build checks pass.
decisions: When env_file is absent, the default <app>/secrets.env is read if present but remains optional; a declared env_file that is missing is a usage error (exit 1).
Parsing supports full-line comments, inline comments on unquoted values, single-quoted literals, double-quoted escapes, CRLF, BOM, and last-value-wins duplicate keys.
Unreadable files report only the errno code, not the lower-level message, so a custom reader cannot leak file content.
A lexical containment re-check in loadEnvironment rejects env_file paths escaping the app directory even if the schema was bypassed.
interfaces: EnvironmentFileError { file, line, exitCode 1, code INVALID_ENV_FILE }
warnings: New stable codes INVALID_ENV_FILE and SECRETS_FILE_MISSING (both exit 1); unreadable secrets reuse SECRETS_UNREADABLE (exit 2), so docs should list the new codes.
ContainerEnvironment.values contains secret material by design; callers must pass it only to the container runtime and use .redacted for any diagnostics.
payload.taskDescription: Implement env.ts to read the optional secrets file, parse KEY=VALUE lines with comments and quoted values, validate variable names, and merge inline [env] with the file so the file wins on duplicates. Reject invalid names with the line number and never include the value. Expose a redacted view for diagnostics. Tests cover comments, quotes, blank lines, duplicate keys, invalid names, a missing file when one is declared, and redaction in error paths.
